topic: Microsoft AB-900 Microsoft 365 Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals certification exam preparation - deploying, securing, governing, and administering Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI agents for IT administrators (core Microsoft 365 features, data protection and governance, and Copilot/agent administration)
cert_name: Microsoft 365 Certified: Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals
exam_format: Approximately 40-60 questions, 45 minutes (block roughly 65 minutes of seat time for instructions and the candidate agreement), passing score 700/1000, taken online-proctored or at a test center. Question types include multiple choice, multiple response, and scenario-based items. Fundamentals-level IT-administrator credential in Microsoft's new AB (AI Business) series; renews annually via a free online Microsoft Learn assessment. The exam fee is approximately USD 165 and varies by region and currency; present any fee as approximate and advise candidates to confirm current Microsoft pricing.
question_types: multiple choice (single answer, exactly 4 options) and multiple response clearly marked as 'Select TWO/THREE', plus short admin scenario questions ('which admin center / control to use', 'best way to prevent oversharing', 'how to govern an agent')
audience: IT administrators and Microsoft 365 admins who deploy, secure, and manage Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI agents: M365/collaboration admins, security and compliance admins, help-desk and workplace-technology staff. Some familiarity with the Microsoft 365 admin center and Microsoft 365 services is helpful. This is the ADMIN track that complements AB-730 (AI Business Professional) and AB-731 (AI Transformation Leader) already in this catalog - together they cover the business user, the leader, and the administrator.
author: Aseem Mankotia

domains.name: Identify core Microsoft 365 features
domains.notes: The Microsoft 365 foundation Copilot relies on: core services and objects - Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, and Loop - and how their content becomes Copilot's grounding via Microsoft Graph. The Microsoft 365 admin center and admin roles; identity and access basics with Microsoft Entra ID (users, groups, licensing); assigning and managing Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses; readiness and prerequisites for deploying Copilot. Crucially, how existing permissions flow into Copilot answers - why broad SharePoint/OneDrive access creates 'oversharing' risk - and where Copilot's data comes from. Read-and-understand admin walkthroughs, not deep engineering.

domains.name: Understand data protection and governance for Microsoft 365 and Copilot
domains.notes: The heaviest domain. Protecting and governing data in an AI-enabled tenant with Microsoft Purview: sensitivity labels and encryption, data loss prevention (DLP), retention and records, information barriers, insider risk, audit, eDiscovery, and Communication Compliance - and how each applies to Copilot and agents. How Copilot HONORS existing permissions and sensitivity labels; SharePoint Advanced Management and restricted SharePoint search to control oversharing before a Copilot rollout; governing Copilot-generated content; enterprise/commercial data protection and privacy posture; managing who can access Copilot and which agents. The recurring skill is choosing the right governance control to keep an AI-enabled Microsoft 365 environment secure and compliant.

domains.name: Perform Copilot and agent administration
domains.notes: Essential day-to-day administration of Copilot and agents: the Copilot admin experience and Copilot Control System; deploying, enabling, and managing Microsoft 365 Copilot; managing and governing AGENTS (the Agent Store and Copilot Studio agents) at an admin level - enabling/disabling, approval and lifecycle, and security controls; Copilot usage, adoption, and health reporting; assigning administrative roles for Copilot; and troubleshooting readiness and access issues. Choosing the correct admin action or control for a described Copilot/agent management scenario.

extra_guidance: AB-900 (Microsoft 365 Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals) is the ADMINISTRATOR fundamentals credential in Microsoft's new AB (AI Business) series - it completes the AB set alongside AB-730 (business user) and AB-731 (leader). MARKETING ANGLE: 'the IT admin's guide to deploying and securing Microsoft 365 Copilot - the third piece of the AB set.' Audience is IT ADMINS, not developers and not end users - there is NO code, but there IS admin-center and governance tooling; frame everything around what an administrator configures. The THREE domain names and weight ranges above are Microsoft's official skills-measured outline (2026) - use them verbatim and present the percentages as Microsoft's published ranges. Note this is the MOST technical of the three AB courses (it involves the Microsoft 365 admin center and Microsoft Purview) but is still fundamentals-level. Use EXACT current Microsoft product names: Microsoft 365 admin center, the Copilot admin / Copilot Control System, Microsoft Purview (sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, eDiscovery, insider risk, Communication Compliance), Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint Advanced Management, restricted SharePoint search, the Agent Store, Copilot Studio, and Copilot usage/adoption reports - with a one-line note that Microsoft's admin and Copilot branding evolves quickly, so verify against current docs. Labs are READ-AND-UNDERSTAND admin walkthroughs (assign a Copilot license, apply a sensitivity label, configure a DLP policy relevant to Copilot, run restricted SharePoint search to curb oversharing, enable/govern an agent, read a Copilot adoption report) - explicitly note most learners will follow along conceptually rather than in a live tenant. Practice questions MUST be scenario-based and test admin judgment: which admin center or control to use, how to prevent Copilot oversharing, how to govern or disable an agent, which Purview control applies, and how to grant Copilot admin access. Cover recurring decisions: permissions/oversharing before rollout, sensitivity labels vs DLP vs restricted search, tenant-wide vs group-scoped enablement, and agent approval/lifecycle. NEVER promise a pass or use the word 'guarantee' in ANY form (Udemy compliance) - use 'exam-focused preparation' framing throughout, including learning objectives and who-this-is-for. Present the exam fee as approximate (~USD 165, varies by region) and note the annual free renewal; advise verifying current Microsoft pricing. The final chapter must be a full exam simulation with a 45-minute time-management strategy. Scan the practice bank for stray other-vendor terms (AWS/Google/NVIDIA) before upload per the pipeline compliance rules.
